title: Valley-Craft
description: A cozy modpack with a realistic touch. Not for lower Devices
body: Valley-Craft is a large, cozy, and realistic Minecraft modpack made for players who love to build, farm, explore, and relax. With mods like Farmer’s Delight, Traveler’s Backpack, Tree Harvester, Visual Workbench, Visuality, Vocal Villagers, Watut, Xaero’s World Map, Zoomify, and many quality-of-life additions, the world feels more alive and immersive. Improved animations, useful tools, interactive villagers, detailed visual effects, and helpful comfort features make every adventure smoother and more enjoyable. Whether you want to create your own village, build massive farms, explore beautiful landscapes, or simply enjoy a peaceful survival experience, Valley-Craft combines cozy gameplay, realistic style, and endless possibilities.
